issues.description: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in highlight() - unescaped HTML injection
issues.suggestion: Escape special HTML characters in title and query terms before wrapping with <mark> tags

issues.description: String.prototype.replace() replaces only the first occurrence of query term
issues.suggestion: Use replaceAll() or a globally flagged regular expression with escaping

issues.description: Empty or multiple spaces in query produces empty search term matching all todos
STOP_WORDS.indexOf() performed repeatedly inside nested loops: O(n * m) complexity
issues.suggestion: Convert STOP_WORDS to a Set for O(1) membership checks

issues.description: Legacy var declarations and loose equality operators (!=, ==) throughout file
issues.suggestion: Replace var with const/let and use strict equality (===, !==)

codeQuality.summary: Multiple high-severity concerns: XSS vulnerability in highlight(), query term parsing bugs, and quadratic search loops.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Primary search entry point is completely untested, risking regressions and faulty filtering
Ranking calculation and sort logic must be validated against tie-breaking and zero matches
Ensure HTML output correctly wraps matched terms and handles HTML entity escaping
End-to-end integration function combining search and rank pipeline

testCoverage.summary: Zero test coverage for new search module. Critical requirement to introduce unit test suite.

suggestions.description: Refactor manual imperative loops to declarative Array.prototype.filter pipeline
suggestions.benefits: Eliminates 3 nested loops, avoids array mutations, handles whitespace bugs, and uses strict types

suggestions.description: Convert STOP_WORDS from Array to Set to achieve O(1) membership lookups
suggestions.benefits: Improves algorithmic time complexity from O(n) to O(1) per token lookup

suggestions.description: Use regular expressions with word boundary or safe replacer and sanitize HTML input
suggestions.benefits: Resolves XSS security vulnerability, replaces all occurrences globally, and preserves case

refactorings.summary: Comprehensive modernization recommended: convert to ES2022 functional constructs and Set lookups.

recommendations.description: Remediate XSS vulnerability in highlight() by escaping HTML characters before injecting <mark> elements
Author comprehensive unit tests in src/search.test.js covering searchTodos, rankResults, and highlight
Fix query tokenization by filtering empty strings from whitespace-separated tokens
Migrate STOP_WORDS from an Array to a Set to reduce nested lookup complexity
Modernize syntax from legacy var to const/let and replace imperative loops with Array.prototype.filter
